title: Chain filter and map together
why_it_matters: Real UI lists usually need both: pick items, then shape them.
explanation: Array methods return arrays, so you can chain them. Filter first to pick the items, then map to reshape them. Read left to right it tells a story: keep in-stock products, then take their names. Filtering first also means less work for map.
try_it: Extend the chain so it also requires a price over 600.
